import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w=w[w.year.notna()].copy()
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
w['prod']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
print(len(w),w.y.mean(),est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
bs=[]
gs={k:v for k,v in w.groupby('genre')}
for i in range(1000):
    bs.append(est(pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in gs.values()])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).y.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
print(pd.crosstab(w.date_confidence,w.late,normalize='columns'))
print(pd.crosstab(w.origin,w.late,normalize='columns'))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','prod']].mean())
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(prod)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'])
print(w.groupby('decade').y.mean())
print(w[(w.y>0)&(w.late==1)&(w.date_confidence=='high')].sample_passage_ids.head(6).tolist())
